data.headline: ELME disclosed intended dissolution and voluntary NYSE delisting

claims.text: ELME provided the NYSE notice of its intention to voluntarily delist its common shares.

citation.quote: provided notice to the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) of its intention to voluntarily delist its Common Shares from the NYSE.

claims.text: The notice was connected to ELME’s intended dissolution and cancellation of its common shares.

citation.quote: in connection with its intended dissolution and the cancellation of its common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share (the “Common Shares”), described under Item 8.01 below

claims.text: The company anticipates filing a Form 25 with the SEC and NYSE on October 26, 2026.

citation.quote: The Company anticipates filing a Form 25, or Notification of Removal from Listing, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) and the NYSE relating to the delisting of the Common Shares on October 26, 2026.

claims.text: ELME identifies rent control, rent stabilization legislation and other regulatory restrictions as factors affecting rent decisions, rent increases and operating-cost pass-throughs.

citation.quote: rent control, rent stabilization legislation and other regulatory restrictions may impact the manner in which we make rent decisions, including restrictions on the use of algorithmic devices or systems, our ability to increase rents and pass through new or increased operating costs to our residents and to evict residents;
